newsitem.title: USA: GTECH says Texas to explore lottery rebid.
newsitem.headline: GTECH says Texas to explore lottery rebid.

text.p: GTECH Corp said on Tuesday that the Texas Lottery Commission voted "to move in the direction of rebidding" the state lottery contract now held by GTECH.
The commission did not formally decide to rebid the contract, but will prepare and analyze eight bidding alternatives to consider, GTECH said.

GTECH said it expects to continue its lottery operations in Texas, which represent about 15 percent of its revenue. The company said it will pursue "all available options" to ensure that the contract, which runs through 2002, is upheld.
GTECH also said California's State Lottery Commission voted to sign the contract extension with GTECH that originally was agreed upon and announced in January. The contract runs through 2003.
GTECH supplies computerized, on-line lottery products and services.
